QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 3 (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: The Republicans need more promotional materials. What could they be?
QuestInfo.1: Cole needs Printer Paper, but none of it was unloaded from the boxes. Break boxes to get the paper!
QuestInfo.2: Return to Cole with your 50 stacks of Printer Paper.

0.0: Paper. I need, you need it, we all need it. And I need a lot of it right now, because the print outs I've been making on my old undies haven't been so popular. Can you unbox some paper in the Speaking Hall?

yes.0: Thank goodness. My wife has been complaining about all the extra laundry.

no.0: I suppose I can deal with a few more pairs of my patriotic knickers in the wild.

yes.0: You're a real red-blooded little helper! Keep this up, and I'll give you something great!

stop.0: Don't get lazy on me. My rear end depends on it!
